blurb: Guests go deep sea bottom fishing or, when in season, halibut and salmon fishing. Reservations are required and made by phone. Fishing licenses must be obtained prior to the trip.
extraNote: Reservations required, made by calling 503-322-3285 · Deposit $50 per person or $500 to reserve entire boat · Payment by cash, check, or debit/credit card; fee for debit/credit cards · Blue metal building with big OCEAN CHARTERS sign at Garibaldi Boat Basin, 10 miles North of Tillamook on Highway 101, turn South on 7th Street

quotes.text: Having used a couple of different local charters since then, I now realize how great of a captain Joe is. Joe was able to put us on some Ling Cod and made sure we all caught our limits. If I do make it back to that part of the Oregon coast, I will definitely use Siggi-G. These guys were great!
Went out with these guys in early june and had an awesome time! Thank you for the fun fishing trip looking forward to seeing you again on the next one. I DEFINITELY recommend Siggi-G to everyone!
We have used them for company fishing trips and always had a stellar time. Always on the fish, always limited out. Definitely recommend.
